snippet.title: Hymer 2000 | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Developed by doBell and published by indienova, the text adventure game Hymer 2000 is set to officially launch on November 13 on Steam, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 4|5. The game will be priced at $4.99 USD and offer a 10% launch discount on Steam.

Hymer 2000 is an interactive text puzzle game, where players freely converse with the "Hymer" and use an open "Search" function to retrieve past conversations. By discovering keywords, gathering clues, and collecting "Faces", players uncover Hymer's secrets and ultimately shut it down.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255860/Hymer_2000/
